title: CI: plugin-hub and lightweight runner + dependency sanitizer
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce friction for adding new CI steps, centralize small reusable CI plugins, and shrink presubmit startup time by introducing a light-weight local runner and a dependency sanitizer that trims dev-only transitive noise. This PR adds a declarative plugins/manifest.json schema, an adapter that loads composable plugin snippets, a minimal runnable local runner binary used by fastpath lanes, and a dependency sanitizer that marks dev-only transitive packages for optional removal in CI images. The goals are faster feedback on small changes, fewer flaky CI runs due to heavy toolchain initialization, and clearer ownership for CI snippets. Checklist: 1) Add plugin manifest and loader; 2) Implement lightweight runner (Go, <2MB static); 3) Add dep-sanitizer job and heuristic rules; 4) Wire new fastpath lane to github workflow; 5) Add docs and migration notes; 6) Add linear links and smoke tests. Testing: unit tests for plugin loader, integration smoke job in ephemeral runner, manual verification on several repos (redwood, redwood-sdk-python, redwood-docs), and staged rollout via feature flag. Rollback plan: flip feature flag to disable fastpath lane and restore original workflow config, revert plugin manifest to prior commit. Related: ENG-1142 (fastpath presubmit), ENG-1175 (dep hygiene), SUP-3421 (support incident about slow presubmit).

merge_info: Merged by squash via GitHub UI after approvals; commit message consolidated to 'ci: add plugin-hub, lightweight runner, and dep sanitizer' and tagged release-note: ci: plugin-hub + fastpath runner
release_notes: Adds a CI plugin manifest and loader for composable CI snippets, a compact fastpath runner to speed presubmit feedback on small changes, and a dependency sanitizer that trims dev-only transitive packages from CI images. Opt-in rollout via feature flag; no production runtime changes.
migration_notes: Teams that maintain repo-specific CI snippets should move snippets to ci/plugins/<team>/ and add an entry in ci/plugins/manifest.json. To opt-in to fastpath, set ci-flag 'fastpath-enabled' in .github/ci-flags.yaml. See docs/ci/migration.md for a step-by-step guide.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for loader and sanitizer; integration smoke run executed in ephemeral runner; manual run across three repositories; CI rerun after timeout adjustments passed cleanly.

notes: This PR intentionally keeps plugin snippets small and opt-in to reduce blast radius. The lightweight runner binary targets minimal dependencies to avoid adding weight to CI images.
